title: 多层网络与表示

notebook.execution_method: Fresh Python process; real ipykernel InProcessKernel; all code cells sequential; saved outputs; no error outputs

additional_checks: forced late serialization failure before writes
author_tests.cast_underflow_regression: Nonzero extended floats +/-1e-400 rejected before float64 loss; true zeros and smallest nonzero binary64 subnormal preserved. Already-rounded Python float zero cannot reveal an earlier underflow.

json_exact_token_regression.fix: parse_float=Decimal; compare fixed values before conversion; normalize accepted config to safe known types

visual_review.notes: Corrected two missing inline TeX escapes, combined a split truth table, moved references before exercises, and expanded figure limits so corner points remain visible. Final PDFs re-rendered and re-viewed. v3 changes no PDF or figure bytes; all 21 previously viewed pages remain byte-identical.

scope_limits: Fully synthetic four-corner logic experiment; no real-world performance claim.
Constructed representation and exhaustive bounded candidate selection, not full-network gradient training.
Universal approximation is an existence statement with conditions, not an optimization, sample-efficiency or generalization guarantee.
Fresh Anaconda creation, browser Jupyter UI, out-of-process sockets and cross-platform installation were not tested.
Output files are fully calculated and serialized before write, but writes are not a multi-file crash transaction and do not defend against concurrent path substitution.
Strict byte checks can reject cross-platform floating-point last-digit differences.
